claims.claim: You need to give business details to register.
claims.quote: When you apply you must: tell us about your premises pay the registration fees due
claims.note: The text requires premises details, BOOMs and fees, but does not list general business details as needed.

claims.claim: You need to give the business's registered address.
claims.quote: You must tell HMRC about your premises when you register for money laundering supervision.
claims.note: The text requires the premises where supervised activity takes place, not specifically the registered address.

claims.claim: You need to identify the business's beneficial owners.
claims.quote: add all beneficial owners, officers or managers ( BOOMs ), referred to as a responsible person on the registration system, on to the application
claims.note: The text requires all beneficial owners to be added to the application.

claims.claim: You need to identify the business's directors.
claims.quote: add all beneficial owners, officers or managers ( BOOMs ), referred to as a responsible person on the registration system, on to the application
claims.note: Officers and managers, which include directors, must be added to the application.

claims.claim: You need evidence of the business type and activities.
claims.note: The text asks for a risk assessment, BOOMs, premises and fees, but does not mention evidence of business type or activities.
